headline: Callum's Cape Foothold Collapses as Mooring County Firefight Intensifies
war_summary: Western lines have shuddered into fresh upheaval as the Colonial breach in Callum's Cape was abruptly wiped out, Warden forces reclaiming six strongholds while reducing one to vacant rubble amid more than eighteen hundred casualties over the past two hours. Further west, Nevish Line has broken its brief lull, reigniting with three swift base contentions and accelerating enlistments right up to the morning wire. Mooring County remains the war's bloodiest crucible, absorbing over twenty-one hundred fresh casualties in two hours with firefights sharply accelerating, though fortified lines around The Wind Hills have not yielded. In the central sector, Marban Hollow persists as an unstable churn around Checkpoint Bua, where two further turnovers leave three redoubts abandoned to no-man's-land and the remaining strongholds split. Weathered Expanse registered additional base shifts to solidify Warden dominance over seven garrisons with two destroyed, while casualty rates across the Linn of Mercy cooled dramatically after earlier heavy battering.
